scope: Bounded independent readback of the selected local AC1024 two-layout, null-background source's strict ASCII and Binary DXF outputs. This qualifies only the semantic fields ACadSharp reconstructs; the remaining source profile and product claims stay open.

source.provenance: Local sample; producer identity is unauthenticated.

reader.name: ACadSharp
reader.result: Both ASCII and Binary DXF outputs load. ACAD_LAYOUT contains Layout1 (handle 0x59) and Model (0x22); both retain owner 0x1A, flags 1, tab orders 1 and 0, and extension dictionaries 0x2A7 and 0x108D. The associated blocks resolve to *Paper_Space and *Model_Space; Layout1 has viewport entities 0x22E2 and 0x22E3 in both outputs.

primaryTypeReferences.finding: The active viewport object is AcDbViewportTableRecord in model space and AcDbViewport in paper space.
LAYOUT group 331 carries the ID/handle of the viewport that was last active in that layout.
Model-space active viewport configurations use VPORT records named *ACTIVE.

asciiLayoutGroup331.Layout1: 0x22E2; emitted VIEWPORT entity owned by mapped *Paper_Space block 0x1E
asciiLayoutGroup331.status: Source-bound LibreDWG class identities and emitted ASCII targets align with Autodesk's API distinction: Model group 331 points to a VPORT/AcDbViewportTableRecord *ACTIVE target, while Layout1 points to a VIEWPORT/AcDbViewport entity. For this sample, the ASCII target roles are supported; Binary physical target values still need direct independent extraction.

acadsharpResolution.status: ACadSharp does not surface group 331 in its DXF object model. DxfObjectsSectionReader.readLayout stores it in LasActiveViewportHandle (source line 428), while CadLayoutTemplate.build resolves ActiveViewportHandle (line 35). The DXF reader therefore drops the captured handle before graph resolution. Its object model also exposes Viewport targets only, so it cannot resolve the model-space VPORT table-record target. Autodesk's ObjectARX documentation confirms the distinct model-space and paper-space target types; ACadSharp's null property is a peer limitation, not evidence of a libdxfrw output defect. Binary physical group-331 values remain unverified.

namedObjectDictionary.rawLocalSourceAndAsciiComparison: The prior bounded comparison reports the same 15 source/output NOD entries, including ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME.
namedObjectDictionary.status: ACadSharp inserts default root entries and omits ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME from its DXF object model even though the existing raw ASCII output comparison finds that key. Its object-model counts are not a faithful NOD parity oracle. Binary NOD semantics remain unqualified.

limitations: This is partial independent semantic readback, not full object-graph closure or native AutoCAD/LibreCAD acceptance.
